rules.title: VALID stability
rules.check: VALID asserted without READY must remain asserted and payload stable

rules.title: Single transfer
rules.check: A transfer occurs exactly when VALID && READY

rules.title: Channel stability
rules.check: Each AXI channel keeps VALID and payload stable under backpressure

rules.title: Response closure
rules.check: Accepted requests are matched by exactly one legal response or an explicit timeout/abort policy

rules.title: Burst boundaries
rules.check: LEN/SIZE/BURST and LAST remain mutually consistent

rules.title: Setup/access order
rules.check: PSEL setup is followed by PENABLE access and held until PREADY

rules.title: Transfer progression
rules.check: Address/control and response progress consistently with HREADY

rules.title: Boundary safety
rules.check: No overflow on full and no underflow on empty
